mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.2% within the last month signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and boosts consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 0.5% month-over-month signals a weakening supply side, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as companies adjust to reduced output and profitability.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 jobs in the last month, it signals strong labor market conditions, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances with strong payroll growth.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.3% month-over-month, it signals inflationary pressure under tight monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: inflationary pressure under tight monetary policy
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 5% month-over-month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2% in the same period, it signals a strong demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 5% MoM and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% MoM
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 2% quarter-over-quarter signals strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances with strong GDP growth.
